pages.title: Overview
pages.text: REBUILD: EDEN is a mini game where you reconstruct and manage Eden's facilities that were destroyed by the Rapture Queen. The ultimate goal is to rebuild Eden.

pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Collect resources and repair facilities to fully rebuild Eden.
Hire mecha units to rebuild facilities and collect resources through Dispatch Missions.

pages.title: HUD - Week
pages.text:
■ This timer shows the passage of time within Eden.
■ A day passes every three minutes, and an environmental event may occur at random.

pages.title: HUD - Summary
pages.text:
■ When the timer reaches one week, a summary is generated.
■ The summary displays the result of the week's reconstruction activities.
■ You can see the changes in resource gains and number of units hired.

pages.title: HUD - Current Resources
pages.text:
■ This bulletin board displays Eden's current resources.
■ From left to right, it displays the amount of Construction Materials, Upgrade Materials, and Special Materials.

pages.title: HUD - Eden Reconstruction Progress
pages.text:
■ Eden's current reconstruction progress is displayed here.
■ Increase progress by completing Main Missions and Side Missions.

pages.title: HUD - Main Menu
pages.text:
This is the main menu for REBUILD: EDEN.
■ Overview: View a summary of the current state of Eden.
■ Construction: Construct facilities within Eden.
■ Squad: Set up squads in Eden.
■ Missions/Dispatches: View the main missions and dispatch missions of REBUILD: EDEN.

pages.title: HUD - Other Menu
pages.text:
This is the sub menu for REBUILD: EDEN.
Missions
■ View challenges that can be completed while playing REBUILD: EDEN.
■ Missions are completed when specific conditions are met.

Storage
■ View resources and equipment you currently own.

Help
■ View helpful information about REBUILD: EDEN.

pages.title: Resources
pages.text:
Construction Materials are the most basic type of resource. They are relatively easy to obtain, but are in high demand.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily)
■ Resource Collection Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions

pages.title: Resources
pages.text:
Upgrade Materials are rarer than Construction Materials. Demand for them is lower, but there are also fewer ways to obtain them.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily starting from Day 12)
■ Underground Resource Collection Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions

pages.title: Resources
pages.text:
Special Materials are the rarest resource. They can only be obtained once you reach a certain stage in the Main Missions.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily starting from Day 20)
■ Energy Conversion Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions

pages.title: Construction
pages.text:
■ Facilities are buildings in Eden with various purposes.
■ In the early stages of the mini game, only certain facilities can be constructed. As you progress through the Main Missions, more facilities will be unlocked.
■ To construct a facility, select a closed tile or access the Construction menu.

pages.title: Construction Method 1
pages.text:
Select a Closed Facility Tile to Construct

1. Select a closed facility tile.
2. Choose your desired facility in the Buy/Construct Facility window.
3. Confirm your selection to proceed with the construction.

pages.title: Construction Method 2
pages.text:
Constuct via the Construction Menu

1. Open the Construction menu on the lower-right corner of the main screen.
2. Choose your desired facility in the Buy/Construct Facility window.
3. Constructible and non-constructible areas will be highlighted based on the selected facility.
4. Select your desired tile and confirm to proceed with the construction.

pages.title: Construction - Elevator
pages.text:
■ The elevator is a facility required to supply power to other floors.
■ If a facility that requires power is constructed on a floor other than the first, it will not operate even if it receives power from the power plant, unless there is an elevator.
■ The elevator can only be installed in the 5th column of the first floor.
■ It also transports hired units between floors, so an elevator must be constructed to access other floors.

pages.title: Construction - Special Facility
pages.text:
■ Some facilities can only be constructed on specific tiles.
■ These facilities can be constructed by completing Main Missions.

pages.title: About Power
pages.text:
■ Power is the energy required to operate a facility after it is constructed.
■ Construct a Power Plant to supply power to its surrounding facilities.
■ The power supply range changes according to the Power Plant's tier.

pages.title: Power Plant Range
pages.text:
■ The Power Plant supplies power to two tiles on its left and right.
■ The Power Plant MK.II supplies power to three tiles on its left and right.
■ The Power Plant MK.III supplies power to a fan-shaped area.
■ The Power Plant MK.IV supplies power in all directions.

pages.title: Facility Upgrade
pages.text:
■ Certain facilities can be upgraded.
■ Each facility type has its own unique upgrade options, which helps improve its efficiency.
■ To upgrade a facility, you must have the required materials for its upgrade level.

pages.title: Facility Demolishment
pages.text:
■ Existing facilities can be demolished via Demolish Facility in Facility Details.
■ Some facilities cannot be demolished once constructed.
■ When a facility is demolished, 100% of the materials used for its construction are refunded.

pages.title: Facility Synergy Effects
pages.text:
■ Some facilities have synergy effects.
■ Construct facilities according to the recommended placement conditions to activate these effects.
■ Synergy effects further improve a facility's efficiency, but in some cases, you may have to reconstruct facilities to activate them. It's recommended to activate them when you have sufficient resources.

pages.title: Facility Synergy Effects
pages.text:
■ You can check a facility's synergy effects before constructing it.
■ You can also view a facility's synergy effects after it has been constructed.

pages.title: Synergy - Power Upgrade
pages.text:
Power Upgrade
■ Increases a Power Plant's power generation by 20 when another Power Plant is constructed on the tile immediately to its left or right.

pages.title: Synergy - Supply Upgrade
pages.text:
Supply Upgrade
■ Increases a Resource Collection Station's base production amount by 1 when a Daily Supply Station is built on the tile immediately to its left or right.

pages.title: Synergy - Squad Assembly
pages.text:
Squad Assembly
■ Increases the success rate of dispatch missions by 5% when Dorm 2, 3 or 4 is built on the tile immediately to the left or right of Dorm 1.

* This effect does not stack.

pages.title: Synergy - Dispatch Upgrade
pages.text:
Dispatch Upgrade
■ Increases the success rate of dispatch missions by 5% when the Employment Management Office and Dispatch Support Station are placed next to each other in order.

pages.title: Synergy - Hiring Upgrade
pages.text:
Hiring Upgrade
■ Decreases the hiring cost of units by 10% when the Employment Management Office, Dispatch Support Station, and Employment Support Office are placed next to each other in order.

pages.title: Synergy - Equipment Production +
pages.text:
Equipment Production +
■ Decreases the Equipment Production Facility's production time by 20% when the Equipment Production Facility and Armory are placed next to each other in order.

pages.title: Synergy - Power Resource Conversion +
pages.text:
Power Resource Conversion +
■ Decreases the Energy Conversion Station's production time by 20% when Power Plants are built on all tiles immediately to its left and right.

pages.title: Synergy - Underground Resource Conversion +
pages.text:
Underground Resource Conversion +
■ Decreases the Underground Resource Collection Station's production time by 20% when Power Plants are built on all tiles immediately to its left and right.

pages.title: Squad - Unit Overview
pages.text:
■ The menu lets you view all units currently hired in Eden.
■ Unit Overview shows the units in each squad, units assigned to facilities, and each unit's tier information.
■ Selecting a unit allows you to view its unique options.

pages.title: Squad - Unit Formation
pages.text:
■ This menu lets you assign units to available squads.
■ Units must be assigned to a squad to carry out dispatch missions.
■ After assigning units, you can equip the squad with any available equipment.

pages.title: Squad - Hire Unit
pages.text:
■ This menu lets you hire units to be stationed in Eden.
■ Units have different attributes and appearances based on their tier. Higher-tier units cost more to hire.

pages.title: Squad - Hire Unit
pages.text:
■ Hired units can move around freely in Eden even if they are not assigned to a squad or facility.
■ They can interact with specific facilities and perform various actions such as producing additional resources.
■ Even lower-tier units can be useful, so don't hesitate to hire them.

pages.title: Squad - Hire Unit
pages.text:
■ Units that no longer need to be stationed in Eden can be dismissed via Dismiss Unit.
■ When a unit is dismissed, 80% of its hiring cost is refunded. Dismissed units can still be rehired later.

pages.title: Facility Assignment
pages.text:
■ Hired units can provide beneficial effects to facilities when assigned via Assign to Facility.
■ Only one unit can be assigned to each facility, so be sure to assign a unit where they'll be the most effective.

pages.title: Mission - Main Mission
pages.text:
■ Main Missions are your top priority during Eden's reconstruction.
■ There are 23 stages in total. As you progress, you'll be tasked with collecting more resources or constructing special facilities.

pages.title: Mission - Side Mission
pages.text:
■ Side Missions can be completed as you progress through Eden's reconstruction.
■ Complete missions to obtain a certain amount of random materials from Construction, Upgrade, or Special Materials.

pages.title: Mission - Dispatch Mission
pages.text:
■ Obtain Construction, Upgrade, and Special Materials essential to Eden's reconstruction through Dispatch Missions.
■ The amount of rewards from each dispatch varies, and success is not guaranteed.
■ You must assign a unit to a squad in order to start a dispatch mission.
■ After a dispatch is completed, the same squad cannot be dispatched again until the waiting time ends.
■ Equipment used by a dispatched squad will be reduced by one in your inventory.

pages.title: Mission - Daily Dispatch Bonus
pages.text:
■ You'll receive three daily dispatch bonuses each day.
■ A daily dispatch bonus is consumed each time you complete a dispatch mission, granting extra rewards beyond the basic ones.

pages.title: Equipment Production Overview
pages.text:
■ You can produce equipment with options that are helpful for Dispatch Missions through Equipment Production.
■ All equipment have unique options and are classified as Alpha or Beta depending on the type of option.
■ Depending on the equipment's tier, specific production requirements or different amounts of resources may be required.

pages.title: Equipment Production Method
pages.text:
Adjustable Quantity Production
■ You can set the quantity of equipment to produce in the Equipment Production Facility.
1. Select the equipment you wish to produce.
2. Adjust the production amount using the -1, -10, +1, and +10 buttons.
3. Select Start Production.

■ Once production begins, the specified quantity will be produced automatically.
■ Production will continue even if you close the Equipment Production window and perform other actions.

pages.title: Equipment Production Method
pages.text:
Unlimited Production
■ You can produce an unlimited quantity of your selected equipment in the Equipment Production Facility.
1. Select the equipment you wish to produce.
2. Select Unlimited Production to set the production amount to unlimited.
3. Select Start Production.

■ Once production begins, it will continue automatically until your resources run out.
■ Production will continue even if you close the Equipment Production window and perform other actions.
If you wish to stop production, tap Stop Production.

pages.title: Stop Equipment Production
pages.text:
■ Equipment production can be stopped using the following methods.
1. Select Equipment Production in the  Equipment Production Facility.
2. Select Stop Production in the Equipment Production window.

pages.title: Environmental Event
pages.text: ■ Construct the Weather Forecast Station, a special facility that allows you to observe the environment around Eden. Environmental events that grant special effects may occur.

pages.title: Environmental Event - Heatwave
pages.text:
Environmental Event: Heatwave
When Environmental Event: Heatwave occurs, the following effects may take place.
■ Resources obtained from Dispatch Missions are decreased.
■ All units' movement speed is increased.
■ There is a small chance the failure rate of Dispatch Missions will increase.

pages.title: Environmental Event - Rain
pages.text:
Environmental Event: Rain
When Environmental Event: Rain occurs, the following effects may take place.
■ Facility production time is increased.
■ All units' movement speed is increased.
■ There is a small chance unit hiring costs will increase.

pages.title: Environmental Event - Storm
pages.text:
Environmental Event: Storm
When Environmental Event: Storm occurs, the following effects may take place.
■ Facility power requirements are increased.
■ Facility synergy effects are increased.
■ There is a small chance the Equipment Production Facility will require more resources.

pages.title: Environmental Event - Snow
pages.text:
Environmental Event: Snow
When Environmental Event: Snow occurs, the following effects may take place.
■ All units' movement speed is decreased.
■ Facility synergy effects are increased.
■ There is a small chance facility synergy effects will decrease.

pages.title: After Clearing
pages.text:
■ Once you complete Main Mission: 23. Rebuilding Eden, you'll be free to manage Eden however you like.
■ You can choose to focus on side missions, or dismiss some units and demolish facilities to reorganize Eden as you wish and play freely.

view.summary: A city builder: rebuild Eden floor by floor. Power your facilities, collect materials, hire units into squads and send them on dispatch missions while following 23 Main Missions to the Command Center.

overview.title: How it plays
items: Complete the 23 Main Missions; each one unlocks new facilities, units, dispatches or equipment. After the last one Eden is yours to rearrange freely.
Pick a tile and a facility; construction takes 3 s. Demolishing refunds 100% of the cost. Some special facilities only fit on fixed tiles.
Most facilities need power from a nearby Power Plant. Above the first floor they also need the Elevator.
An in-game day passes every 3 min; a weekly summary follows every 7 days. With the Weather Forecast Station built, a random weather event can occur each day.
The hire list offers 5 units; rerolling it costs 150 Construction Materials. Dismissing refunds 80% of the hiring cost.
Send a squad for materials. Success is not guaranteed; a super success gives ×2 rewards. 3 Daily Dispatch Bonuses a day add extra rewards. Equipment used on a dispatch is consumed.
The rerun (Arcade) uses the same missions and has its own set of challenges.

overview.title: Materials
rows:
A basic material necessary for facility construction and equipment production.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily)
■ Resource Collection Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions

An essential material for facility construction and upgrades, as well as equipment production. It is highly durable.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily starting from Day 12)
■ Underground Resource Collection Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions

An essential material for facility construction and upgrades, as well as equipment production. It is extremely rare and can be processed in many ways.

Obtain from
■ Daily Supply Station (daily starting from Day 20)
■ Energy Conversion Station (periodically after construction)
■ Dispatch Missions
